_doc: Gen 9 (Gen 6+) type effectiveness chart. Only non-neutral multipliers are listed; any attacker -> defender pair not listed defaults to 1.0x. For dual-type defenders, multiply the two values: Fighting into Fairy/Flying = 0.5 * 0.5 = 0.25.

modifiers.strongWinds: Tinkaton-Gamma's Parasol Prayer and Mega Rayquaza's Delta Stream set Strong Winds. While active, moves that would be super-effective against pure Flying-types (Ice, Rock, Electric) instead deal NEUTRAL (1x) damage to all Flying-types. Re-run the math for any Flying-type defender when Strong Winds is up.
modifiers.levitate: Levitate (and Air Balloon) makes the holder Ground-immune regardless of type. Archapult (HA Levitate), Hoopa-Delta, and Magigrigus commonly run it. Set Ground -> Levitate user multiplier to 0x.
modifiers.waterAbsorb: Water Absorb (Ogerpon-Wellspring) makes the holder Water-immune. Set Water -> mon multiplier to 0x. Note: Alomomola in delta ranked runs Regenerator, not Water Absorb HA, so do NOT treat Water -> Alo as immune.
modifiers.flashFire: Flash Fire (Heatran) makes the holder Fire-immune. Set Fire -> mon multiplier to 0x.
modifiers.scrappy: Scrappy (Mega Lopunny) lets Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost-types. Set Normal/Fighting -> Ghost multiplier to 1x (then apply the second type as normal).
